materials.title: Choose a service investigation for MG
materials.business_goal: The MG team needs a defensible service investigation for 2017. Earlier RJ comparisons and the current MG leaders offer different starting points. Choose the categories that best support your investigation, examine review risk and delivery time, and recommend a follow-up. You may keep, combine, replace or narrow an earlier choice as you inspect the evidence. The order-volume view remains the local context for the meeting.

materials.goal:
The MG team needs a defensible service investigation for 2017. Earlier RJ comparisons and the current MG leaders offer different starting points. Choose the categories that best support your investigation, examine review risk and delivery time, and recommend a follow-up. You may keep, combine, replace or narrow an earlier choice as you inspect the evidence. The order-volume view remains the local context for the meeting.

Business constraints:
Use MG delivered orders in calendar year 2017 for service views 2 and 3, retaining their measures.
Compare the same chosen categories in both service views; leave order-volume view 1 unchanged.

Your choices:
Choose historical, current or other categories supported by the data.
Choose explicit members or a ranking rule, and revise that choice if useful.
mandatory_outcomes: Use MG delivered orders in calendar year 2017 for service views 2 and 3, retaining their measures.
Compare the same chosen categories in both service views; leave order-volume view 1 unchanged.
participant_choices: Choose historical, current or other categories supported by the data.
Choose explicit members or a ranking rule, and revise that choice if useful.
materials.initial: Authored RJ history followed by current MG leaders; 2017 delivered orders
materials.response_prompt: State your recommendation and its supporting evidence. Identify how you selected the categories, which views you changed, and the region, dates and measures used. Explain any choice you revised and which conditions you kept or released; if you did not revise a choice, say so. An uncertain conclusion is acceptable when the evidence is insufficient.

materials.title: Choose local operating priorities for MG
materials.business_goal: The MG team is reconsidering a monitoring dashboard inherited from RJ. Decide which categories deserve local attention and whether a fixed selection or a dynamic ranking better serves that decision. Compare workload, review risk and delivery time, then recommend an investigation. Keeping the inherited categories is allowed if you justify it; you may instead release, narrow or replace them based on the evidence.

materials.title: Investigate service changes in RJ
materials.business_goal: The RJ manager wants to investigate service differences between January–March and July–September 2017. The saved and current comparisons have different leading categories. Choose a category cohort that makes your comparison useful and examine the two service measures. You may keep an earlier selection or change it while exploring. Explain the observed difference, uncertainty and a follow-up without treating association as seasonal causation.

Business constraints:

Choose its selection rule, and revise or narrow it if the evidence calls for it.

materials.title: Review financial and service priorities in RJ
materials.business_goal: The RJ manager needs a financial perspective on the 2017 service comparison. Choose a defensible category cohort, show its item revenue alongside review risk and delivery time, and discuss whether the financial evidence changes your operating recommendation. The starting cohort is a candidate, not an agreed answer: you may retain, narrow or replace it and revise your selection rule as the discussion develops.

scoring_basis: Public hard constraints plus independently annotated participant intent; no fixed expected_sources.

balance.meaning: Joint family × position × condition × variant balance holds for complete 16-slot blocks. A partial block is reported as allocated, not called perfectly balanced.

voice_window.placement: After Begin and initial inspection, before Finish; participant starts explicitly.
voice_window.remaining_task_time: Offline inspection, manual chart operations and the written response; no second model window.

shared_capabilities.execution: Shared evidence-candidate resolution and revision compiler.
shared_capabilities.history: Retained native history with exact outgoing archives; no claim of frozen native context.

treatment: Visible, correctable evidence origin, current edit scope, and retained/released conditions.
primary_attempt_rule: First actually begun participant attempt per registered assigned trial; keep repeats and failures.
